Q1: This chemical has a known hazard for inhalation (Tier 1). While it shows a demonstrated low/moderate oral hazard (Tier 3), it is largely data deficient (Tier 4) for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive, environmental, endocrine disruption, dermal/eye, and organ/systemic hazards.
Q2: Cellulase is on the EPA's Safer Choice "SCIL Yellow Triangle list," indicating it meets Safer Choice criteria for its function but has some hazard profile issues and is not considered low hazard for all human health and environmental endpoints.
Q3: Despite extensive literature (64,000 references), Cellulase is structurally poorly characterized, indicated by an "Unspecified" molecular formula and "Manual Registration" substance class. It lacks rigorous EPA toxicological assessments (IRIS or PPRTV) and has a low number of toxicity values, with most hazard classes being data deficient (Tier 4).
